record.rationale: Uses the pinned pako low-level z_stream API for initialization, DEFLATE, reset, end and preset dictionary. Normal continuation, sync flush and stream finish use zlib flush values. Array and status bindings use public fields.

stackDivergence.rationale: Actual pinned pako2.1.0 public low-level zlib implements deflateInit2, deflate, deflateReset and deflateEnd. The browser boundary marshals native Sequence bytes into library typed-array pointers; it neither reads private state nor injects counters nor synthesizes reset from destruction. Original level/window/memory/strategy/flush defaults, source Sequence retention, error return ordering and independent64-bit overflow accumulation remain in Deflater. Compression, reset/reuse, tiny output, native COW and real ZIP reopening are tested. Fatal allocation failures, invalid native pointer domains and actual greater-than4GiB rollover remain unqualified. Full package/storage/filter/model/UI acceptance is unfinished.
